E0926

`#Every(…)`'s argument isn't a valid schedule — bad canonical Time unit, non-positive or out-of-range duration, or malformed/out-of-range `"HH:MM"` (D-SCHEDULE1, card #505)

What

`#Every(…)`'s argument isn't a valid schedule — bad canonical Time unit, non-positive or out-of-range duration, or malformed/out-of-range `"HH:MM"` (D-SCHEDULE1, card #505)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0926

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0926: tests/ui/schedule_bad_duration_unit.stderr.

Error [E0926]: this duration's unit isn't a recognized schedule cadence
  --> tests/ui/schedule_bad_duration_unit.jet:3:15
    |
  3 | #[Job, Every(5px)] fn prune_sessions() {
    |               ^^
 Why: a schedule's repeat interval uses the canonical Time family — `ns`/`us`/`ms`/`s`/`min`/`h`/`d` — not an arbitrary `#UnitFamily` member.
 Fix: use a canonical Time unit such as `min`, `h`, or `d` (e.g. `#Every(2h)`).
